about: Sparring M2 run 2: run 1's sighted defenders backed out of the ring (val: A survival_in_ring 0.0, drift 5.3 m). Run 2 anchors the defender to the ring and keeps run 1's pass rule.
written: 2026-10-29, before any run-2 code ran on GPU; after run 1's val, training logs AND test summary were viewed (576727a)

changes_vs_run1.tasks: R1-Spar-Block2-A / R1-Spar-Block2-Blind (gpu/sparring_task.py _block2); the run-1 tasks and every default are unchanged bit for bit (tests/test_sparring_r2.py against tests/fixtures/sparring_task_576727a.py)
changes_vs_run1.attacker: aim commits at max(onset, apex - 0.15 s) (SCHED_R2.commit_s, = r1gym/aim.py commit_s); spot cap 0.3 m/s unchanged; row 1.0 kg / 60 N / -0.02 m (SPAR_ATTACK), capsule proxies, 3072 envs (run 1's deviations, carried over: run 1's gate 1 picked the row from the predeclared GPU retune grid, section 8 item 29, and its gate 2 passed only at 3072 envs on capsule proxies; declared again on the pod through SPAR_CALIB_DEVIATION)
changes_vs_run1.ring: spar_ring +2.5 x (1 - clip((r-0.25)/0.75,0,1)) per s; ring_out termination at r > 1.0 m (-4, like a fall); r = pelvis xy distance from the episode start
changes_vs_run1.rewards: A weights; spar_block 40, paid only when the arm contact opened by apex + 0.05 s AND no head or torso hit landed in that window after it (a graze that does not stop the strike pays nothing); spar_clearance only for strikes in reach at the latch (excess over D <= 0.05 m); stand_still on legs and waist only

candidates.A2: R1-Spar-Block2-A, --agent.seed 42 (run 1 A's seed: results/policy_mjlab_spar_a/params/agent.yaml), 1500 iterations from widen2(model_7496.pt), final checkpoint
candidates.blind2: R1-Spar-Block2-Blind, same seed as A2 (42), same start
candidates.training_order: A2, blind2, A2s. A2s is skipped only if blind2 finishes more than 2.4 h after A2 started training (pod_run2.sh checks the clock; this keeps the pod under about $3.6); the screen then runs on A2 alone

gates.gate1: python gpu/sparring_task.py m1check --r2 1, capsule proxies, 3072 envs, frozen guard_fw_r: head clean/min >= 7.7 and median impulse per landed head hit in [1.58, 3.56]. Rows in order: (1.0,60,-0.02), (1.0,50,-0.02), (1.0,40,-0.02); first passing row is used; none: no training.
gates.gate2: A2 iterations 20-200: <= 2.2 s/iteration and no NaN terminations in A2's log (read at iteration 200 and again on the whole log); fail: stop after A2, no selection
gates.smoke: a 3-iteration load smoke of both run-2 tasks before A2 checks they build, load widen2's checkpoint and log the ring terms; not a gate on any number
gates.logged_not_gated: Episode_Termination/ring_out, fell_over, mean episode length, ring_max_m, spar_arm_idle_touch

eval.script: scripts/eval_opponent.py --tier hard_r2 --no_pushes --hits 1 --keypoints truth; unaimed first, then --aim chosen in the same --out
eval.val: --split val --reps 32 (kfab_204 x 4 distances x 32 = 128 bouts; seeds 21000-21127); controllers guard_fw_r, A2, A2s (if trained), blind2 (reported)
eval.test: --split test --reps 16 (kfab_202, kfab_205 x 4 x 16 = 128; seeds 22000-22127), once, guard_fw_r + selected + blind2 in one invocation; refused unless m2_run2_selection.json has go = true

selection.rule: On val, aimed: candidates A2 and A2s qualify with survival >= 0.95, survival_in_ring drop vs guard_fw_r <= 0.05, and head-clean R_warm (point) <= 0.80. Among qualifiers, the lower exposure-weighted head clean/min; a difference < 0.1/min picks A2. No qualifier: go = false, the test is not run, run 2 is reported as failing at the screen.
selection.twin: blind2 for either; for A2s it is not seed-matched (reported)

statistics: identical to prereg_m2.json statistics, source raw_test_hard_r2_nohits_aim.json
rule: identical to prereg_m2.json rule (head_vs_warm R <= 0.60 and CI upper < 0.80; head_vs_blind CI upper < 0.90; torso R <= 1.5; survival >= 0.95; ring drop <= 0.05; all five)
blocks_claim: the write-up says 'blocks' only if the head-intent STOPPED share (arm contact first and no head or torso hit landed in that window, from the same HitMeter events) rises by >= 0.10 vs guard_fw_r (paired cluster CI > 0) and head slip (closest approach) stays within 3 cm of guard_fw_r's; otherwise 'avoids' (not part of pass). Run 1's blocked share (arm first, landed or not) is reported alongside
reported_regardless: prereg_m2's list, plus the exploit screen in section 7 (vs guard_fw_r): drift at 5 s and 20 s; pelvis/head z p10; bearing error; late head displacement t_on..t_apex; arm-on-idle-fist share; opp_fall; falls with no hit in the previous 1 s

test_integrity.reseeded: Run-2 episodes are re-seeded on the same clips: seeds 21000+ for val and 22000+ for test give new start times, delays, domain randomisation and hit draws, but the opponent replays the same motion. Seeds and env seeds are disjoint from run 1's (tests/test_m2_run2.py).
test_integrity.reused: There is no clean alternative clip: kfab_199 cannot be performed by the tracker, and the train clips feed the GPU attacker. So run 2 uses the same test clips, kfab_202 and kfab_205, and the same val clip, kfab_204. 66% of the new test start times (87% on val) fall within 0.1 s of a run-1 start.
disclosures: run 1's test summary was committed and seen (survival 0.750, ring 0.0) before run 2 was designed
run 2's design came from run 1's val runs and training logs
controls: This prereg is committed and hashed before the pod launches. Selection and verdict record its hash and the git hash.
The eval refuses hard_r2 on the test split unless the selection says go (scripts/eval_opponent.py r2_test_allowed, against this file's current hash).
The test is run once, with three controllers in one invocation and identical episodes.
The eval also refuses a second hard_r2 test run into an --out that already holds raw_test_hard_r2 files.

budget: one RTX 4090 pod: gate 1 about 5 min per row (up to 3), 3 x 1500 iterations at about 1.95 s/iteration = about 2.45 h, about $3.3 plus up to $0.2 for gate 1

amendment.name: run 2 restart (run 2b)
amendment.written: after A2's aborted training log was seen and before any run-2b code ran on GPU; every key above this one is unchanged
amendment.what_happened: The first run-2 pod passed gate 1 (head clean 14.46/min, median 3.31 N*s per landed head hit, row 1.0/60/-0.02) and gate 2 (2.05 s/iteration over iterations 20-200, no nan). A2 (R1-Spar-Block2-A, seed 42) was then stopped by hand at 266 of 1500 iterations because it was learning to leave the ring: mean episode 241 steps (4.8 s; run 1 A about 15 s), ring_out 80% of episode ends (fell_over 20%, time_out under 1%), action std 0.64 -> 0.94. No A2 checkpoint was exported or evaluated; blind2 and A2s were never trained.
amendment.seen: A2's aborted 266-iteration training log (spar2_A2.log, iterations 7496-7761), the 3-iteration smoke logs of both run-2 tasks and the gate 1 / gate 2 outputs of that pod. No run-2 eval has run: the hard_r2 val (seeds 21000-21127) and test (seeds 22000-22127) episodes are unused and stay this prereg's eval.
amendment.why: With gamma 0.99 per 0.02 s step (a 2 s horizon) and time-outs bootstrapped, ending an episode (ring_out or a fall, -4) pays wherever the local reward rate is below about -2 per live second. As A2's action std rose, the sampling-noise part of action_rate_l2 and the other smoothness terms took the rate excluding is_terminated from +0.78 per live second (iterations 20-29, std 0.70) to -1.03 (256-265, std 0.94), and to -3.01 at the ring edge, where spar_ring tapers to 0. The section 9.2 claim that the bonus keeps every live second worth more held only at std 0.65-0.78.

changes.spar_alive: R1-Spar-Block2-A and R1-Spar-Block2-Blind (train and play cfg) gain the reward term spar_alive = 1 - terminated (mjlab is_alive's rule: 0 on the step a fell_over / ring_out / nan ends the episode, 1 on every other step including a time-out), weight ALIVE weight 4.0, i.e. +4.0 per live second. At A2's last rates this makes the mean state +2.97 and the ring edge +0.99 per live second (+2.5 and +0.5 projected at std 1.0), so no termination pays in either the discounted or the undiscounted frame.
changes.warm_start: widen2b = widen2 plus ALIVE v_shift +8.0 (= 4.0 x 0.02 / (1 - 0.99)) on the critic's output bias (critic_state_dict mlp.6.bias, -0.025 -> 7.975); actor, normalisers and optimiser state identical to widen2's. The warm-start critic then over-estimates rather than under-estimates the new value, so a termination looks worse, not better, while the clipped value loss (clip 0.2 per iteration) catches up.
changes.early_stop: Predeclared, applied by the pod to A2 and A2s (python gpu/sparring_task.py watch, WATCH; exit 3 = stop) at iterations 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, ..., 1500, counted from the run's first logged iteration, on the 20 iterations ending there. Stop if any of: E1 the edge rate (every logged Episode_Reward term except spar_ring and is_terminated, x 20 / (Mean episode length x 0.02)) is below 0 per live second; E2 the termination hazard ((ring_out + fell_over + nan per step) / (3072 x 0.02)) is above 0.22 at 50, 0.19 at 100, 0.17 from 150 on; E3 the iteration's Mean action std is above 0.80 at 50, 0.85 at 100, 0.90 from 150 on. The 1500 check is reported, never a stop (training is done), and a watch error in A2 or A2s is a stop. On A2's aborted log E2 and E3 stop it at 200 (hazard 0.182, std 0.91; 0.162 / 0.87 at 150); run 1's A and Blind logs never trip E2 or E3.
changes.consequences: A2 stopped: run 2 ends there (no blind2, no A2s, no selection, no eval), reported as failing in training. A2s stopped: it is not a candidate and the val screen runs on A2 alone, as when A2s is skipped for budget. blind2 is watched and reported but never stopped by this rule (it is the control and always trains 1500 iterations). Stopped runs are exported only as policy_mjlab_<run>_stopped for diagnosis and are never evaluated.
changes.pod: scratchpad run2b/pod_run2b.sh: widen2b into widen_spar2b, the smoke also requires Episode_Reward/spar_alive, the early stop above, results packed as m2r2b.tar. Gate 1 and gate 2 are rerun unchanged on the new pod.

amendment.unchanged: Task IDs and run names (R1-Spar-Block2-A / -Blind; spar2_A2, spar2_blind2, spar2_A2s), WEIGHTS A2, RING (bonus and the ring_out termination at 1 m), SCHED_R2, HIT_R2, stand_still joints, ring_home, the attacker row and its gates, the PPO settings (entropy 0.01, unclamped std, gamma 0.99, lam 0.95), seeds, 1500 iterations, training order and the 2.4 h A2s budget rule, eval, selection, statistics, rule (pass), blocks_claim, reported_regardless and test_integrity. The task IDs now mean the run-2b definition; A2's aborted log came from the earlier one.
amendment.rejected: Capping the action std (a custom rsl_rl distribution on the pod's training path, untested against tyro and rsl_rl 5.0.1, and it limits exploration below run 1's 0.76-0.81) and removing the ring_out termination (a soft ring would train against a weaker constraint than the eval's 'never more than 1 m from the start').
amendment.budget: One RTX 4090 pod at 0.89 USD/h: setup and gate 1 about 5 min, 3 x 1500 iterations at about 2.05 s = 2.56 h, about 2.5 USD in all; an early stop of A2 at 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 costs about 0.18 / 0.20 / 0.23 / 0.26 USD including boot and download.
